// Runtime assertions for queue names built from channel parameters.
// Dropped into the tmp module's paramqueuev1 package next to the
// generated file.

package paramqueuev1

import (
	"context"
	"slices"
	"testing"
)

type recordingTransport struct {
	queue string
	keys  []string
}

func (r *recordingTransport) Subscribe(_ context.Context, queueName string, bindingKeys []string,
	_ func(ctx context.Context, routingKey string, body []byte) error) error {
	r.queue, r.keys = queueName, bindingKeys
	return nil
}

type auditHandler struct{}

func (auditHandler) HandleAuditEvent(context.Context, AuditEvent) error { return nil }

type archiveHandler struct{}

func (archiveHandler) HandleArchiveEvent(context.Context, ArchiveEvent) error { return nil }

func TestSubscribeAuditEvent_QueueNameUsesTenant(t *testing.T) {
	tr := &recordingTransport{}
	if err := NewSubscriber(tr).SubscribeAuditEvent(context.Background(), "acme", auditHandler{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if tr.queue != "acme.audit-log" {
		t.Errorf("queue = %q, want %q", tr.queue, "acme.audit-log")
	}
	if want := []string{"acme.orders.created"}; !slices.Equal(tr.keys, want) {
		t.Errorf("binding keys = %q, want %q", tr.keys, want)
	}
}

func TestSubscribeArchiveEvent_QueueNameUsesTypedRegion(t *testing.T) {
	tr := &recordingTransport{}
	if err := NewSubscriber(tr).SubscribeArchiveEvent(context.Background(), RegionEu, "acme", archiveHandler{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if tr.queue != "archive.eu" {
		t.Errorf("queue = %q, want %q", tr.queue, "archive.eu")
	}
	if want := []string{"eu.acme.orders.archived"}; !slices.Equal(tr.keys, want) {
		t.Errorf("binding keys = %q, want %q", tr.keys, want)
	}
}
